title: A. Arpa's loud Owf and Mehrdad's evil plan

legend: As you have noticed, there are lovely girls in Arpa’s land.
People in Arpa's land are numbered from 1 to n. Everyone has exactly one crush, i-th person's crush is person with the number crushi.
Someday Arpa shouted Owf loudly from the top of the palace and a funny game started in Arpa's land. The rules are as follows.

The game consists of rounds. Assume person x wants to start a round, he calls crushx and says: "Oww...wwf" (the letter w is repeated t times) and cuts off the phone immediately. If t > 1 then crushx calls crushcrushx and says: "Oww...wwf" (the letter w is repeated t - 1 times) and cuts off the phone immediately. The round continues until some person receives an "Owf" (t = 1). This person is called the Joon-Joon of the round. There can't be two rounds at the same time.

Mehrdad has an evil plan to make the game more funny, he wants to find smallest t (t ≥ 1) such that for each person x, if x starts some round and y becomes the Joon-Joon of the round, then by starting from y, x would become the Joon-Joon of the round. Find such t for Mehrdad if it's possible.
Some strange fact in Arpa's land is that someone can be himself's crush (i.e. crushi = i).
input: The first line of input contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) — the number of people in Arpa's land.
The second line contains n integers, i-th of them is crushi (1 ≤ crushi ≤ n) — the number of i-th person's crush.
output: If there is no t satisfying the condition, print -1. Otherwise print such smallest t.
note: In the first sample suppose t = 3.
If the first person starts some round:

The first person calls the second person and says "Owwwf", then the second person calls the third person and says "Owwf", then the third person calls the first person and says "Owf", so the first person becomes Joon-Joon of the round. So the condition is satisfied if x is 1.
The process is similar for the second and the third person.
If the fourth person starts some round:

The fourth person calls himself and says "Owwwf", then he calls himself again and says "Owwf", then he calls himself for another time and says "Owf", so the fourth person becomes Joon-Joon of the round. So the condition is satisfied when x is 4.
In the last example if the first person starts a round, then the second person becomes the Joon-Joon, and vice versa.

legend.ai: 正如你所注意到的，Arpa 的土地上有许多可爱的女孩。
Arpa 国的人编号为 1 到 n。每个人恰好有一个喜欢的人，第 i 个人喜欢的人编号为 crushi。
有一天，Arpa 在宫殿顶上大声喊了一声 Owf，Arpa 国里便开始了一场有趣的游戏。游戏规则如下。

游戏由若干轮组成。假设某人 x 想要开始一轮游戏，他会给 crushx 打电话，并说：“Oww...wwf”（字母 w 重复 t 次），然后立刻挂断电话。如果 t > 1，那么 crushx 会给 crushcrushx 打电话，并说：“Oww...wwf”（字母 w 重复 t - 1 次），然后立刻挂断电话。这一轮会持续进行，直到某个人收到“Owf”（t = 1）。这个人被称为本轮的 Joon-Joon。不能同时进行两轮游戏。
Mehrdad 有一个邪恶的计划，想让这个游戏变得更有趣。他想找到最小的 t（t ≥ 1），使得对于每个人 x，如果 x 开始某一轮游戏，而 y 成为本轮的 Joon-Joon，那么从 y 开始一轮游戏时，x 会成为本轮的 Joon-Joon。如果可能，请为 Mehrdad 找到这样的 t。
Arpa 国里有个奇怪的现象：有些人喜欢自己（即 crushi = i）。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，假设 t = 3。
如果第一个人开始某一轮：
第一个人打电话给第二个人并说“ Owwwf”，然后第二个人打电话给第三个人并说“ Owwf”，接着第三个人打电话给第一个人并说“ Owf”，于是第一个人成为这一轮的 Joon-Joon。因此，当 x 为 1 时，条件得到满足。
对于第二个人和第三个人，过程类似。
如果第四个人开始某一轮：
第四个人喊自己的名字并说“Owwwf”，然后他再次喊自己的名字并说“Owwf”，接着他又一次喊自己的名字并说“Owf”，因此第四个人成为这一轮的 Joon-Joon。所以当 x 为 4 时，条件得到满足。
在最后一个例子中，如果第一个人开始一轮，那么第二个人会成为 Joon-Joon，反之亦然。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100）——Arpa 的领地中的人数。
第二行包含 n 个整数，其中第 i 个整数为 crushi（1 ≤ crushi ≤ n）——第 i 个人喜欢的人的编号。

output.ai: 如果不存在满足条件的 t，输出 -1。否则输出这样的最小 t。
